title: The Car Mystery (Hook)
text: Imagine a car driving very fast. Suddenly, it stops! The driver tries to start it, but it won't move. The petrol tank is completely empty! Have you ever wondered what happens to your body when you play outside all day without eating?

title: Socratic Question
text: Why do we feel tired and hungry? If a car needs petrol to move, what does your magical body need to run and jump?

content.title: The Human Engine
content.description: Just like a car needs fuel to run, our body needs food for energy.

title: The Great Discovery
text: Food is the fuel for our body! When we eat, our body gets special magic called Energy. Energy helps us to run, play, think, and grow big and strong. Without food, we would be like a car without petrol.

title: The Reveal: Sources of Food
text: We get our food from two main sources: Plants and Animals. Plants give us fruits (like apples), vegetables (like carrots), and grains (like rice). Animals give us milk, eggs, and meat. Drinking milk helps our bones become super strong!

content.definition: The power that our body uses to play, work, and grow.
Food that makes our body strong and helps fight diseases. Examples: Fruits, milk, and vegetables.

content.question: What gives our body energy to play and grow?
Which of these foods do we get from plants?

content.title: Reflection Time
content.text: Explain in your own words why we need food. Tell your family what food you had for breakfast today and guess if it came from a plant or an animal!

title: Knowledge Connection
text: Farmers work very hard in the fields to grow our food. Sunlight and rain help plants grow and make this food. In the future, you will discover the amazing secret of how plants cook their own food using sunlight!

content.title: Kitchen Detective (Mastery)
content.text: Go to your kitchen with an adult. Become a Food Detective! Find 3 food items that come from plants and 2 food items that come from animals.

content.title: Junk Food Alert!
content.text: Many children think chocolates, chips, and colas are good food because they taste sweet. But these are Junk Food! Eating too much of them can make our tummy ache and does not give us real strength.
